column1: # Per-host totals for examples/dual-plane.dc: how much each server sent, in
# Gb/s, with no word on where to. Tick "load the cables (estimated)": each
# host's total is sent to the others in proportion to their own totals (the
# gravity model planners use to guess a traffic matrix), routed over the
# fabric, and drawn on the cables. R01 is the busy rack, and R02/s5 the one
# hot server in a quiet one.
